# hubStudio

> hubStudio is a full creative production house that pairs real studio craft with deep AIGC (AI-generated content) expertise, run out of China where the production economics still work. Brands send a brief and the work ships in days, or run the content platform with their own team. Output covers twenty service lines: social, ad creative, video, motion, ecommerce, web, brand identity, strategy, and sales communications.

## About

- [The Studio](https://hubstudio.ai/the-studio): Who hubStudio is, how production runs, and why brands move their content operation here.
- [Who we are](https://hubstudio.ai/the-studio/who-we-are): The production house behind the work, headquartered in Hong Kong with studios in Shanghai, Changsha, and the Philippines.
- [Our creative talents](https://hubstudio.ai/the-studio/creative-talents): Creatives embedded in sixteen markets.
- [Our AI excellence](https://hubstudio.ai/the-studio/ai-excellence): Generation infrastructure used at studio level.

## Services and solutions

- [Services](https://hubstudio.ai/services): Twenty creative service lines under one studio.
- [Solutions](https://hubstudio.ai/solutions): Engagements shaped for brands, agencies, retailers, and manufacturers.
- [hub4You](https://hubstudio.ai/hub4you): The private AI content platform: custom agents trained on a brand, run by the brand's own team.
- [Pricing](https://hubstudio.ai/pricing): Three ways to work: asset-based, project-based, and subscription.
- [Work](https://hubstudio.ai/work): Selected client case studies across beauty, automotive, consumer tech, and retail.
